Get LBA Box Score

Source: R/lba.R
lba_box_score.Rd

Box score of a final game: one row per player of both teams (Italian-named stat columns).

Endpoint: GET https://www.legabasket.it/api/championships/get-championships-matches-scores-by-id (info=true&id=<game_id>)

Usage

lba_box_score(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(required) Game id (game_id in lba_calendar), e.g. 25602. Global across seasons.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Box score of a final game: one row per player of both teams (Italian-named stat columns). The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py lba_box_score); a column the site adds later is appended after them:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id (global across seasons); joins lba_calendar and lba_game.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27): the row's START year + 1.
sidecharacterWhich team of the game the row belongs to: home or visitor.
team_idintegerTeam-season id (re-issued every season); join lba_teams for the stable club_id.
player_idintegerPlayer id (global).
player_numintegerJersey number the player wore in the game.
player_surnamecharacterFamily name, upper case.
player_namecharacterPlayer's given name.
player_codecharacterPlayer code SURNAME3-NAME3-YY.
player_p_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl).
punintegerPoints (punti).
minintegerMinutes played, whole minutes (minuti); 200 in totals = 5 x 40.
secintegerSeconds played (secondi) = min x 60 in every sample.
sfcharacterStarter flag (starting five), number sent as a string: 1 = started.
falli_cintegerFouls committed (falli commessi).
falli_sfintegerFouls drawn (falli subiti).
falli_tc1integerTechnical fouls (falli tecnici; reading tc1 as category-1 technicals is inferred).
falli_flaintegerUnsportsmanlike / flagrant fouls (falli antisportivi).
t2_rinteger2-point field goals made (tiri da 2 realizzati).
t2_tinteger2-point field goals attempted (tiri da 2 tentati).
t2_percdouble2-point field-goal percentage, 0-100 (number; 0 when no attempt).
scintegerDunks (schiacciate).
t3_rinteger3-point field goals made.
t3_tinteger3-point field goals attempted.
t3_percdouble3-point field-goal percentage, 0-100.
tl_rintegerFree throws made (tiri liberi realizzati).
tl_tintegerFree throws attempted (tiri liberi tentati).
tl_percdoubleFree-throw percentage, 0-100.
rimbalzi_ointegerOffensive rebounds (rimbalzi offensivi).
rimbalzi_dintegerDefensive rebounds (rimbalzi difensivi).
rimbalzi_tintegerTotal rebounds (rimbalzi totali).
stoppate_datintegerBlocks (stoppate date).
stoppate_subintegerOwn shots blocked (stoppate subite).
palle_pintegerTurnovers (palle perse).
palle_rintegerSteals (palle recuperate).
assintegerAssists credited to the player in the game.
val_legaintegerLBA efficiency rating (valutazione Lega).
val_oerdoubleOER = points / (FGA + turnovers + FTA / 2); verified on every 2026-27 sample row.
plus_minusintegerPlus-minus: point margin while on court.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the JSON API that the Next.js site www.legabasket.it itself calls. Legal notice: the site's terms say "Non e' consentito copiare ... dati e informazioni senza autorizzazione scritta" (copying data and information without written authorisation is not allowed), except for personal, non-commercial use. The owner accepted the restriction for this intake on 2026-10-12. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and any published data release of this source needs separate sign-off.

  • robots.txt allows /api and sets Crawl-delay: 2. The runtime waits 2 s before every request, retries included. Crawl incrementally: fetch a final game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one lba_calendar call per round, and do not backfill a history in a burst.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026-27); the site sends START years and the runtime maps them (season - 1 on the wire). Game and player ids are global; team ids are re-issued every season (join lba_teams for the stable club_id); a championship id is one season AND one phase (Regular Season and Play Off differ).

  • Play-by-play starts in 2017-18 and changes shape in 2019-20 (pixel frame to court percent) and 2021-22; see lba_pbp. Box scores reach back to 1995-96, where the period scores were not recorded (0 means missing).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or a body with no rows: an unknown season, a play-by-play before 2017-18, standings of a finished championship without a round), hoopR_bad_request (a season that is not an END year, a bad choice, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, an empty / non-JSON / error-shaped 200, a game that is not final on the box score, play-by-play and shot routes, a truncated page, or a body for another season, championship, game, team, player, round or category than the one asked for). An unknown id is HTTP 500, which is not retried. A body the parser finds no rows in gives a zero-row tibble with these columns.
